_doc: Curated stance-entry overrides: performing one of these move ids makes the recognizer assume that stance for a few seconds, enabling stance-move recognition (ZEN.1, KIN.2, ...). Most transitions are detected automatically from wavu data (the recovery field like 'r15 KIN', or notes like 'Enter KIN ... with 1+2') — add ids here only when a stance move isn't being recognized after its entry.
